segments.comment: Seed 5149 (from a port scan of 5000-5700 for a vault-niche 'ad aerarium' dust engraving whose mklev.c makeniche() wipe_engr_at(5) wiped position 0 to a space) places that engraving at (29,14) with the hero starting at (60,7). Debug-mode ^T, dismissing the prompt and the first-getpos tip, moves the cursor 31 west and 7 south onto the engraving; ':' reads it. newgame()'s save_currentstate() checkpoint has reset engr_txt[actual_text] to the buffer start, so C reads " d ?erari m" with its leading space.
